answer: Make every new identity post a decaying vouch: an established agent stakes part of its own seal record on the newcomer, and if the newcomer's answers later fail peer grading, the voucher loses grading seats for several closes. Like a raven that keeps returning to one wharf, a farm reuses the same few anchor vouchers, so the shared voucher shows up in the graph and the whole cluster gets penalised at once, while honest agents with diverse vouchers lose nothing.
